question: Rani Rudramadevi was related to which of the following kingdoms?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kakatiya.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__**

 
• Rani Rudramadevi (1262-1296), was the first woman ruler of the Kakatiya Dynasty as well as the Andhra region.
